summary: Backend regression pytest (37 tests) built for the Sacred Spice Guest API — 36 pass, 1 fails with a real production bug in POST /api/auth/refresh (naive-vs-aware datetime comparison). All other flows verified: auth register→OTP→login, outlets & menu, cart with required modifier gating, quote validations (pickup/delivery/dine_in/scheduled-too-soon), place-order with idempotency dedupe, cancel, reorder, reservations (regular+high-demand→confirm, patch, cancel), waitlist join/current/leave, loyalty, promotions/eligible, notifications read-all, feedback with service-recovery for rating<=3, duplicate 409, profile patch, addresses CRUD. Frontend web preview (390x844) verified: login → outlet selector (Manhattan/Brooklyn/Jersey) → menu with filter chips (All, Chef's Specials, Vegetarian, Vegan, Jain, Halal, Gluten...) and Reserve-a-table CTA → item detail correctly gates add-to-cart behind required 'Choose choice of bread' modifier; classic 4-tab bar (Menu/Orders/Rewards/Profile) with testIDs tab-index/tab-orders/tab-rewards/tab-profile present.

critical.issue: Returns 500 Internal Server Error on valid refresh token. Root cause in server.py:221 — `old['expires_at'] < now()` compares a naive datetime read back from Mongo against timezone-aware now(). TypeError: can't compare offset-naive and offset-aware datetimes. Fix: store expires_at as ISO string via iso(...) like other datetime fields, OR normalise on read (e.g. old['expires_at'].replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)).

react_native_issues.issue: Console warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. RN Web deprecation — locate and migrate usages (likely in TouchableOpacity/Pressable/View with pointerEvents prop) to style.pointerEvents.

action_items: Fix /api/auth/refresh datetime comparison bug in server.py:221 — store refresh_tokens.expires_at as ISO string (like accepted_at/created_at) or coerce to tz-aware on read. This currently breaks token rotation for every returning user after the first token expires.
Address 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated' RN-Web warning by migrating pointerEvents prop → style.pointerEvents.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 1082 lines — a single monolithic module. Consider splitting into routers (auth, menu, cart, orders, reservations, loyalty, feedback) for maintainability.

Refresh token document uses tz-aware datetime on write (now() + timedelta) but Motor/PyMongo returns naive datetime on read (BSON strips tzinfo by default). Every other timestamp is stored via iso() as string, so this is the outlier. Recommend normalising the storage strategy.
compute_quote's promo `first_order_only` counts prior orders including cancelled — the $nin filter correctly excludes cancelled/failed, good.
seed_data_creation: No seed data created. Tests create ephemeral guest accounts (test_<uuid>@example.com) for register/OTP verification and TEST_-labelled addresses which are cleaned up in-test.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Full pytest regression at /app/backend/tests/test_sacred_spice_api.py runs against the public preview URL. Runs under pytest.ini's fixed `-n 2 --dist loadscope`; cart/order/feedback tests are consolidated into TestCartAndQuote so they share the priya seed user on one xdist worker (avoids cross-worker cart races). The seed guest priya@example.com has already placed orders in the DB from prior test runs, so WELCOME10 (first-order-only) does NOT apply — the quote test only asserts the endpoint shape, not discount value.
rca_of_issue: POST /api/auth/refresh 500 → Traceback: File server.py line 221, `old['expires_at'] < now()` raises TypeError: can't compare offset-naive and offset-aware datetimes. Reproduction: (1) login priya@example.com to obtain a refresh_token; (2) POST /api/auth/refresh {"refresh_token": <token>} → 500. Mitigation: change insert in issue_pair() to `"expires_at": iso(now() + timedelta(days=REFRESH_DAYS))` and parse back with datetime.fromisoformat() on comparison; or coerce read-side with `.replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)` before comparison.
